headline: NYY @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.11 at NYM 4.33, with a projected total of 8.45. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYY moved -1.30 runs while NYM moved +0.66, changing the projected margin by -1.96 runs. The projected total fell -0.63, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Huascar Brazobán has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, Aaron Judge, Paul Goldschmidt, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ryan McMahon, MJ Melendez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
